patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops Nova's telemetry and ad-mediation network calls at the source: Amplitude (incl. Session Replay), the Novalytics raw-data upload, the ad-mediation config fetch, and the runtime re-enable of Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics (which would otherwise go through Google Play Services). Works with or without the Internet-removal patch; together they are defence in depth.

patches.name: Enable Prime
patches.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime by starting the app in the prime state and reporting an active subscription, so the settings and features gated on Prime are available. Also stops the Play-licence revocation that would otherwise strip Prime from a re-signed (patched) install.

patches.name: Remove internet & tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes the INTERNET permission (OS-enforced offline mode: the core launcher — home, drawer, gestures, widgets, local backup/restore, local search — keeps working; weather, Nova Now promo cards, Sesame integrations, Nova AI and update checks simply stay empty) plus ad-tracking permissions (Ad ID, install referrer, licence check), and disables Branch Search, Audience Network, FCM and GMS measurement components.
